hooks.name: Move Chunk Files to .ultron/chunks
hooks.description: Automatically moves chunk_*.txt files created in the workspace root into .ultron/chunks/ to keep the root clean.

action.command:
#!/bin/zsh
# Move any new chunk_*.txt from workspace root into .ultron/chunks/
WORKSPACE="/Users/IMSAYYED2401/Code/ultron"
DEST="$WORKSPACE/.ultron/chunks"
mkdir -p "$DEST"
find "$WORKSPACE" -maxdepth 1 -name "chunk_*.txt" -exec mv {} "$DEST/" \;
exit 0
